Connection.Name: Listener Connection
Connection.Label: Configure Connection
Connection.Hint: Set the URL events are posted to and the shared secret the listener expects, and test the connection.

Characters.Name: Connected Characters
Characters.Label: Choose Characters
Characters.Hint: Choose which player characters are connected to the listener. Connected characters' hit points are included in combat events, and every event says which of them may see it.

ChatEvents.Name: Send Chat Events
ChatEvents.Hint: Post chat messages to the listener as they are created, edited and deleted.

ChatScope.Name: Chat Messages to Send
ChatScope.Hint: Send every chat message, or only those spoken by a connected character.

CombatEvents.Name: Send Combat Events
CombatEvents.Hint: Post combat tracker changes to the listener: encounters starting and ending, turns and rounds, and combatants joining, leaving, rolling initiative and being defeated.

GmContent.Name: Send Gamemaster-Only Information
GmContent.Hint: Also send what only a Gamemaster can see: whispers no player can read, blind rolls, hidden combatants, the hit points of unconnected combatants and the armor class of attack targets. Leave this off if players can see what the listener receives.

Connection.Title: Sending Stone: Listener Connection
Connection.Hint: Events are posted as JSON, one per request, from the active Gamemaster's browser. Nothing is sent while no Gamemaster is connected.
Connection.UrlHint: The http or https address that receives events. The listener must allow cross-origin requests from this Foundry server.
Connection.SecretHint: Optional. Sent as a bearer token in the Authorization header. Stored only in this browser, so players cannot read it; enter it in each browser a Gamemaster runs the game from.
Connection.BridgeNone: No Gamemaster is connected, so nothing is being sent
Connection.TestOk: Delivered: the listener answered HTTP {status} in {elapsed} ms.
Connection.HintNetwork: Check that the listener is running and reachable from this computer, and that it answers the browser's CORS preflight (OPTIONS) request with Access-Control-Allow-Origin, and Access-Control-Allow-Headers covering Content-Type and Authorization.
Connection.HintMixedContent: Foundry is served over https but the listener URL is plain http, which browsers block for any host other than localhost. Serve the listener over https.
Connection.HintAuth: The listener rejected the request. Check the shared secret.

Characters.Title: Sending Stone: Connected Characters
Characters.Hint: Connected characters are the ones the listener acts for. Their hit points are included in combat events, chat can be limited to their messages, and every event lists which of them may see it.
Characters.None: There are no player characters in this world.

Error.InvalidUrl: The listener URL must be a full http or https address.
Error.Network: the listener could not be reached
Error.Timeout: the listener did not answer in time

Notify.Failing: Sending Stone cannot deliver events to the listener: {error}. Events are being dropped until it recovers.
Notify.Recovered: Sending Stone is delivering events to the listener again.
